i wanted to know about the ewu and admisioin process

[SOURCE: EWU_DOCUMENTS] [CONFIDENCE: HIGH]

East West University (EWU) offers a comprehensive admission process for prospective students. Applicants can fill out online admission forms available on the EWU website by paying Tk. 1,000. For foreign students, the admission form fee is $13.00, payable via International Money Order in favor of EWU. 

To qualify for admission, candidates must pass an admission test, which assesses their English language skills (including structure, vocabulary, comprehension, and composition) and basic mathematics. The dates for these tests are announced in major daily newspapers. Additionally, applicants must submit copies of their Marks Certificates/Transcripts and Testimonials from SSC & HSC or “O” & “A” levels during the admission process.

For more detailed information, you can visit the official EWU admission website at [http://admission.ewubd.edu](http://admission.ewubd.edu).
